issues: Recurring Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount. Non-blocking, charts render (6+ recharts-wrapper elements). Pre-existing issue from iter-7.

critical_code_review_comments: vigilance.py correctly computes worst-of-today-and-tomorrow merge per phenomenon and surfaces overall_level as max across 5 depts. Hardcoded thresholds (wind 70/100/130, precip 25/50/100) are reasonable Météo-France-style approximations; may want to externalise to config in future.
vigilance.py imports `_cached` from weather module — private-looking name (leading underscore). Consider exposing it as public helper (`cached`) to avoid the implicit API contract.

Disclaimer is returned in every response (good), but it's not rendered in VigilanceBanner expanded view verification (not asserted in tests). Main agent may want to confirm disclaimer text is shown to users in the expanded panel.
Timeline preset buttons use inline labels in SAUTER À row — accessible and clearly labelled. No issues found.
WeatherLayers frame-slider + play-pause-frames visible simultaneously when timelineDriven was previously hiding frame-slider; test confirmed both are now present. Good.
